scope: One source-linked, incomplete Crustacea species dossier. The batch records one bounded laboratory reproductive observation; it is not a complete species account or systematic review.

identity.scope: Nominal species as represented by COL26.8 usage 6CCSV. The cited laboratory study uses a cultured stock from the National Institute of Environmental Research, Korea, and does not compare populations or establish a complete species concept.

claims.text: In the laboratory study, vitelline-envelope formation in parthenogenetic Daphnia magna eggs began about 20 minutes after oviposition and took about 20 minutes to complete.
claims.locator: Results, 'Formation of the vitelline envelope in parthenogenetic eggs'; Fig. 4B; Discussion
claims.placeTimeScope: Cultured animals obtained from the National Institute of Environmental Research, Incheon, Korea; study published in 2019. Timing applies to the observed laboratory parthenogenetic eggs.
claims.lifeStatus: Observed in cultured, parthenogenetic females and eggs under the reported laboratory conditions; not generalized to wild populations or other egg types.

gaps: The study does not establish variation among genotypes, populations, environments or other reproductive modes, and does not provide a complete life-history account.

reasons: Only one laboratory reproductive observation was assessed; six facets remain not-assessed.
